title: Aurum Alpha message envelope (CloudEvents 1.0 profile)
description: standards/055-messaging.md AM1: a CloudEvents 1.0 event in JSON structured format, with the choices the specification leaves open pinned. This schema does not restate CloudEvents; it constrains it. Ids, timestamps and trace fields are $refs into the identifiers and observability contracts. Extension attributes are closed: a new one is added here, in its own change, per PC6 - which is why additionalProperties is false.

id.description: Minted by the producer. With source, the event's identity and the consumer's deduplication key (AM3) - which CloudEvents guarantees unique per event.

source.description: The producing service, named LOGICALLY and identically in every environment: /invoicing. Never a hostname - source is half of the event's identity, and an identity that differed between staging and production would make one event two. A third party's events are re-enveloped with the provider as source (/stripe), per AM8.

type.description: resource.event, snake_case, PAST TENSE: invoice.voided. The service is not repeated because source names it. A type's meaning never changes; a different meaning is a different type. The past-tense half is not mechanically checkable - invoice.void matches this pattern and is wrong - and stays a review question.

subject.description: The public id of the entity the event is about, per IP1. Never an internal key.

time.description: When the occurrence happened, not when it was published. RFC 3339 UTC Z per IP4.

dataschema.description: The JSON Schema data conforms to, carrying its version in the URI. Additive change under one URI; breaking change under a new one (PC6).

traceparent.description: The CloudEvents distributed-tracing extension, required by this profile: the trace of the request or job that produced the event, per OC1.

tracestate.description: Forwarded when present, never parsed, never logged - per OC1.

tenantid.description: The tenant public id where tenant context exists - the same value the producer logs as tenant_id. Spelled without the underscore because the CloudEvents attribute grammar admits only lowercase letters and digits; the standard's grammar is adopted rather than fought (PC2).

data.description: The payload: what a consumer needs to act, never a copy of the whole aggregate. snake_case keys per HA8; primitives per the identifiers contract.
